reason: A DSH web-profile provider bundle that integrates the OpenCode Go API, exposes an opencode-go model route, maintains a model catalog, and offers connection diagnostics plus optional configuration migration.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 配置文件接入 OpenCode Go API，提供 opencode-go 模型路由、模型目录缓存、连接诊断和配置迁移功能。
summaries.en: Integrates the OpenCode Go API into a DeepSeek Harness web profile with an opencode-go model route, model catalog caching, connection diagnostics, and configuration migration.

capabilities: Connects to the OpenCode Go API to retrieve model availability and provide an opencode-go model route
Reads and stores an OpenCode Go API key through the DSH credentials service
Maintains a local model catalog cache
Provides status, diagnostics, connection testing, and disconnect operations
Can migrate and atomically rewrite a specified YAML configuration file
